scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/isard && tsc -p packages/isard/tsconfig.worker.json && tsc -p packages/isard/tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p apps/demo && tsc -p apps/bench && tsc -p examples && tsc -p scripts
scripts.lint: biome check . && cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo clippy --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -- -D warnings && cargo clippy -p isard --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --no-default-features -- -D warnings && cargo clippy -p isard-pointcloud --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --features module -- -D warnings
scripts.test: cargo test && cargo test -p isard --no-default-features && bun test packages/isard
scripts.docs:dev: bun run build && bun scripts/docs.ts && bun --filter @isard/docs dev
scripts.docs:build: bun run build && bun scripts/docs.ts && bun --filter @isard/docs build
